description: Table A1, "Composition information of phases", is a single rendered table (no micrographs, spectra or curves). Its columns are Sample, Element and "Content (wt%)", the latter subdivided into five phase columns headed F, B/TM, FM, RA and DIM; neither the image nor the caption expands these abbreviations. Rows are grouped under three sample labels, AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T, each spanning four element rows: C, Mn, Al and Si. For AN750-T, C is 0.02, 0.30, 0.53, 1.40 and 1.40 wt% across F, B/TM, FM, RA and DIM; Mn is 2.43, 3.50, 3.50, 4.10 and 4.1; Al is 2.10 in F, B/TM and FM but 1.40 in RA and DIM. AN800-T gives C = 0.02, 0.35, 0.57, 1.20, 1.20 and Mn = 2.70, 2.80, 3.00, 3.80, 3.80, with Al printed as "2" for the first three phases and 1.70 for RA and DIM. AN850-T gives C = 0.02, 0.50, 0.59, 1.03, 1.03 and Mn = 2.84, 2.92, 2.92, 3.60, 3.60, with Al 2.10 then 1.30. Si is 0.40 wt% in every cell of every sample. RA and DIM are numerically identical throughout, C in RA/DIM decreases as the sample label rises 750 → 800 → 850, and within each sample C and Mn are lowest in F.

observations.observation: The figure is a rendered table (Table A1) reporting element content in wt% for C, Mn, Al and Si in five phase columns labelled F, B/TM, FM, RA and DIM.
Three sample blocks are listed: AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T, each containing the same four element rows C, Mn, Al, Si.
For AN750-T the C content is 0.02 wt% (F), 0.30 (B/TM), 0.53 (FM), 1.40 (RA) and 1.40 (DIM).
For AN750-T the Mn content is 2.43 wt% (F), 3.50 (B/TM), 3.50 (FM), 4.10 (RA) and 4.1 (DIM).
For AN750-T the Al content is 2.10 wt% in F, B/TM and FM and 1.40 wt% in RA and DIM.
For AN800-T the C content is 0.02 wt% (F), 0.35 (B/TM), 0.57 (FM), 1.20 (RA) and 1.20 (DIM); Al is printed as '2' for F, B/TM and FM and 1.70 for RA and DIM.
For AN850-T the C content is 0.02 wt% (F), 0.50 (B/TM), 0.59 (FM), 1.03 (RA) and 1.03 (DIM); Al is 2.10 for F, B/TM and FM and 1.30 for RA and DIM.
The Si content is 0.40 wt% in every cell of all three samples and all five phase columns.
The RA and DIM columns carry numerically identical values in every row of every sample block.
C content in the RA/DIM phase decreases in the order AN750-T (1.40) > AN800-T (1.20) > AN850-T (1.03), i.e. with increasing annealing-temperature suffix 750 → 800 → 850.
Within each sample block, C and Mn contents are lowest in the F column and highest in the RA/DIM columns.
The caption identifies the item only as 'Table A1 Composition information of phases'.
The phase abbreviations F, B/TM, FM, RA and DIM are not expanded in the image or in the caption.
